dedupe_keys.name: pv ice photovoltaic circular economy model

description: PV ICE is the national laboratory's dynamic model of photovoltaic material and energy flows. It tracks annual deployment cohorts through degradation, lifetime, reuse and recycling pathways. Inputs describe deployment schedules, module designs, material properties and circular-economy scenarios; outputs include effective capacity, virgin-material demand, waste and lifecycle energy balances. Geographic coverage follows the scenario, and annual cohorts can span any configured horizon, such as 2020 to 2050. Python source is free under BSD-3-Clause. A limitation is that the supplied crystalline-silicon baselines use market-share averages and projected technology changes; other technology baselines are described as future work. The model supports photovoltaic deployment, material-supply and waste-infrastructure planning. PVDeg (platform-pvdeg) provides related component-degradation calculations. The repository documents baseline sources and a 2022 methods paper, but no baseline tables or scenario outputs were downloaded.
inputs: PV deployment schedules, module and material baselines
